The customer attempted to sign up for Tamara and received an "ID already exists" error message.
Primary Questions (Must answer 2):
Last 4 digits of their National ID
Date of Birth (Exact Gregorian/Hijri as per CS Panel)
Contact number the customer is trying to register on
Mandatory Action (Ask the customer to share): 👇
A clear photo/snippet of their National ID to confirm legal ownership
A screenshot of the error shown on the Tamara App
If provided, move to Investigation Steps.
2- Identity Discovery via Collection Agency
The customer was contacted by a collection agency for unpaid Tamara dues they claim they do not owe.
Primary Questions:
Last 4 digits of National ID
Date of Birth (Exact Gregorian/Hijri as per CS Panel)
Contact number / Email address the agency contacted the customer
Mandatory Action: Ask the customer to share a clear photo/snippet of their National ID.
If provided, move to Investigation Steps.
3- Identity Discovery via SIMAH Record
The customer found a "NAKHALAH" (Tamara) record on their credit report while applying for a loan or checking their credit score.
Primary Questions:
Last 4 digits of National ID
Date of Birth (Exact Gregorian/Hijri as per CS Panel)
Share the order reference ID, default amount, default date for SIMAH records for Tamara
Mandatory Action: Ask the customer to share a clear photo/snippet of their National ID.
If provided, move to Investigation Steps.
4- Discovery via New User Registration (Recycled Phone)
The customer was able to log in to Tamara but does not recognize the account.
Primary Questions (Must answer 2):
Last 4 digits of National ID
Date of Birth (Exact Gregorian/Hijri as per CS Panel)
Contact number the customer is trying to register on
Mandatory Action (Ask the customer to share):
A clear photo/snippet of their National ID to confirm legal ownership
A screenshot of the National ID shown within this account on the Tamara interface
If provided, move to Investigation Steps.
5- Active User Discovery (Account Takeover / Suspicious Activity)
The customer is an existing Tamara user who discovers someone else is using their identity (e.g., suspicious notifications, unauthorized purchases, or finding another account linked to their ID).
Primary Questions (Must answer 2):
Last 4 digits of National ID
Date of Birth (Exact Gregorian/Hijri as per CS Panel — do not use online Hijri converters)
Registered Email Address
Secondary Questions (If 1 primary is missed):
Last payment method + last 4 digits of card
Date of last placed order or installment
Total amount of last placed order or last installment paid
Mandatory Action: Ask the customer to share a clear photo/snippet of their National ID.
If provided, move to Investigation Steps.

Understanding Accrued Murabaha/Service Fee
In case of refunds/cancellations:

The customer will only be charged the accrued Murabaha profit (if applicable) for the number of days they have used the contract (from the contract start date until the cancellation or refund date). They will not be charged the Murabaha profit for the full month.
The amount due is calculated automatically by the system based on the actual number of days the contract was used.
What is accrued Murabaha/هامش الربح?
The Murabaha profit earned from the contract start date until the end of the contract, calculated on a daily basis. You can see it already calculated as below:
Under the Interest Fee column, you’ll see the accrued Murabaha profit for each installment. The amount differs for each installment and gradually decreases until the final installment.

For example, the 161.45 shown for the first installment represents the Murabaha profit accrued between the order date (August 30) and the first installment date (October 10). For this 30-day period only, the total accrued Murabaha profit is 161.45, which equals approximately 5.38 per day.

Customer’s Eligibility
Tamara's risk engine is responsible for evaluating customer eligibility and assigning the corresponding status, which cannot be overridden by Care agents.
Eligibility status
What it means
Eligible (true)
The customer has sufficient available credit and meets Tamara's risk requirements for the requested order amount.
As a result, the Tamara payment option is displayed and can be selected at checkout.
Not Eligible (false)
The customer either has no available credit limit or does not meet Tamara's risk requirements for the requested order amount at that time.
As a result, the Tamara payment option may be hidden or displayed as unavailable (greyed out) on the merchant's checkout page.

Zero Credit Limit: The customer currently has an available spending capacity of SAR 0.
High-Risk Profile: Tamara’s risk engine has flagged the customer’s account as high-risk.

This issue type covers customers who were charged fees by a merchant that were not disclosed or agreed to at the time of checkout. This includes customers who:
1. Were charged a price different from what was displayed on the merchant's website or at checkout,
2. Were asked by the merchant to pay a surcharge or handling fee specifically for using Tamara,
3. Found that the merchant's in-store price was higher when paying with Tamara compared to cash or card,
4. Were told by the merchant that a minimum purchase amount applies when using Tamara, which was not communicated upfront.
Order > Murabha - Pay By Finance > Required Documents
This issue type covers customers who have questions or issues with the documents presented to them for signing during the Pay by Finance (Murabha) checkout process. This includes customers who:
1. Did not receive the documents to sign during checkout
2. Are unable to open, view, or sign the required documents
3. Have questions about what they are being asked to sign
Order > Murabha - Pay by Finance > Signed contract
This issue type covers customers who are requesting a copy of their signed Pay by Finance (Murabha) contract after completing their purchase. This includes customers who:
1. Did not receive a copy of their signed contract after checkout
2. Want to retrieve a copy of their signed contract for their records
3. Need their signed contract for personal, legal, or financial documentation purposes
Order > Placing an Order > Can't see Tamara as a payment option
This issue type covers customers who cannot see or access Tamara as a payment option at a merchant's checkout. This includes customers who:
1. Cannot find Tamara listed as a payment option at checkout,
2. See Tamara at checkout but it is greyed out or cannot be selected,
3. Can see Tamara on the merchant's website but not in the app, or vice versa.
Does not include: Tamara is visible at checkout but only shows Pay in Full (PIF) with no instalment options → use Order > Placing an Order > Can't See Split Payment Options (only PIF).
Order > Placing an Order > Didn't receive the order OTP
This issue type covers customers who are not receiving, or are experiencing delays with, the OTP required to confirm and complete their Tamara order. This includes customers who:
1. Did not receive an OTP SMS when attempting to place an order,
2. Received their OTP after it had already expired,
3. Report that the OTP was sent to the wrong number,
4. Have requested the OTP multiple times without success.
Order > Placing an Order > Instore - did not receive the payment link SMS
This issue type covers customers who did not receive or are unable to use the payment link SMS sent during an in-store Tamara transaction. This includes customers who:
1. Did not receive the payment link SMS when attempting to pay in-store,
2. Received the SMS but the payment link had already expired.
3. Report that the SMS was sent to the wrong number.
4. Have requested the payment link multiple times without receiving it.
Order > Placing an Order > Maximum/minimum purchase limit
This issue type covers customers who have questions or concerns about their Tamara purchase limit or spending power (pre-qualification). This includes customers who:
1. Want to know how to use pre-qualification feature to understand their purchasing power,
2. Ask why their limit is low or lower than expected,
3. Notice their limit decreased unexpectedly,
4. Ask how to increase their purchase limit,
5. Want to understand what factors determine or affect their limit,
6. Ask whether their limit resets after making a repayment,
7. Ask why their limit differs across merchants or purchase categories,
8. Were previously approved for a higher amount but their current limit is now too low for their purchase.
Order > Placing an Order > Order verification IVR call
This issue type covers customers who have questions or issues related to the order verification call (IVR) that Tamara initiates when placing certain orders. This includes customers who:
1. Did not receive the verification call when placing an order,
2. Missed the verification call and find their order is now on hold or cancelled,
3. Are unable to complete the IVR verification due to a technical issue or language barrier,
4. Want to understand why a verification call is required for their order,
5. Ask whether an alternative verification method is available instead of a call.
Order > Placing an Order > Declined order
This issue type covers customers whose order was not approved by Tamara, or who want to understand why their order was declined. This includes customers who:
1. Had an order declined and want to understand the reason,
2. Have no overdue payments but were still declined,
3. Were approved by another BNPL provider but declined by Tamara,
4. Were declined at a specific merchant but have been approved at others,
5. Find the decline reason unclear or believe it was applied in error,
6. Want to know what steps they can take to get approved in the future.
Does not include:
1. Order placed successfully but not visible in the app → Order > Placing an Order > Cannot See Order (Stuck Order).
2. Payment method failing at checkout → Payment > Unable to Pay Pending Dues.
Order > Placing an order > cannot see order (expired order)
This issue type covers customers whose order has expired before it was completed or confirmed. This includes customers who:
1. Cannot find an order they attempted to place and the order has since expired,
2. Did not complete checkout in time and their order session timed out,
3. Are confused about why their order disappeared after they thought it was placed,
4. Want to know if they can reinstate or re-place an expired order,
5. Were charged or had a hold placed on their account before the order expired and want to know if they will be refunded.
Does not include:
1. Order placed successfully but stuck in Authorized/Approved status → Order > Placing an Order > Cannot See Order (Stuck Order).
2. Order that was declined before completion → Order > Placing an Order > Declined Order.
Order > Placing an Order > cannot see order (stuck order)
This issue type covers customers who successfully completed checkout but whose order is not appearing or processing correctly on the merchant's or Tamara's side. This includes customers who:
1. Placed an order that is showing as Authorized or Approved in Tamara but has not been processed or fulfilled by the merchant,
2. Were charged the down payment but the order never appeared on the merchant's system,
3. Can see the order in the Tamara app but the merchant has no record of it,
4. Received a Tamara order confirmation but the merchant has not acknowledged or dispatched the order,
5. Were charged by Tamara but have no order confirmation from the merchant.
Does not include: Order was declined before completion → Order > Placing an Order > Declined Order.
Order > Placing an Order > Chose the wrong installment plan
This issue type covers customers who selected the wrong payment plan when placing their order and want to change or correct it. This includes customers who:
1. Accidentally selected Pay in Full (PIF) instead of an instalment plan, or vice versa
2. Want to switch between instalment plans (e.g. from 3 to 6 instalments or vice versa)
3. Did not realize they chose the wrong plan until after the order was confirmed
4. Want to cancel and re-place their order with the correct payment plan
5. Selected the wrong plan on an order where a partial payment has already been made
Order > Placing an Order > Link Bank Account
This issue type covers customers who are being asked to connect their bank account to Tamara for credit verification and have questions or issues with the process. This includes customers who:
1. Want to understand why Tamara requires them to link their bank account
2. Are concerned about the security or privacy implications of linking their bank
3. Encounter an error or repeated failure when attempting to link their bank account
4. Cannot find their bank listed in the bank linking options
5. Completed the bank link but Tamara still shows it as incomplete or pending
6. Linked the wrong bank account and want to update it
Order > Placing an Order > can't see a specific split payment option (X)
This issue type covers customers who can see Tamara at checkout but cannot see or access a specific split payment option they expect to be available. This includes customers who:
Can see other Tamara payment options but a specific instalment plan is not appearing at checkout
Previously had access to a specific plan but it is no longer showing
Want to understand why they are not eligible for a specific split payment option
Can see a specific plan at some merchants but not others
Does not include:
1. No Tamara payment options showing at all → Order > Placing an Order > Can't See Tamara as a Payment Option
2. Only Pay in Full (PIF) is showing with no instalment options at all → Order > Placing an Order > Can't See Split Payment Options (Only PIF)
Order > Placing an Order > Can't see Tamara's split payment options (only PIF)
This issue type covers customers who can see Tamara at checkout but are only being offered the Pay in Full (PIF) option, with no instalment plans available. This includes customers who:
1. See Tamara at checkout but only PIF is showing, with no 3, 4, 6 or other instalment options,
2. Previously had instalment options available but they are no longer appearing,
3. Want to understand why they are not being offered instalment plans,
4. Can see instalment options on some merchants but not others.
Does not include:
1. Tamara is not appearing at checkout at all → Order > Placing an Order > Can't See Tamara as a Payment Option
2. Si6 specifically is missing but other instalment options are visible → Order > Placing an Order > Can't See a Specific Split Payment Option (Si6)
Order > Placing an Order > Can't see a specific split payment option (SiX)
Customers who report that certain split payment options (e.g. Si2, Si3) are available, but they cannot see another expected option (e.g. Si4).
Order > Dispute > Cancel dispute
This issue type covers customers who want to withdraw or cancel a dispute they previously raised with Tamara. This includes customers who:
1. Want to know how to cancel an open dispute themselves,
2. Are requesting Tamara support to cancel a dispute on their behalf,
3. Filed a dispute in error and want it withdrawn before it is actioned.
Does not include: Customer wants to cancel a return or order (not a dispute) → use Refunds and Cancellations or Order > Dispute > Return / Cancellation Not Processed
Order > Dispute > Item not as described
This issue type covers customers who received an item that does not match what was expected without clear signs of intentional deception. When intentional fraud is not suspected, use this issue type.
This includes customers who:
1. Receive an item different from what was ordered.
2. Receive damaged items.
3. Receive counterfeit items from merchants they believe are legitimate.
Does not include:
Customers explicitly suspecting scam behavior or intentional deception → use Merchant Fraud.
Order > Dispute > Item or order not delivered

This issue type covers customers whose orders are delayed, missing, or not delivered while the merchant is assumed to be legitimate. Use this issue type when the issue is limited to delivery or fulfilment.
This includes customers who:
1. Did not receive all or part of their order.
2. Experience delivery delays beyond the promised timeframe.
3. See tracking marked as delivered but did not receive the order.
Does not include:
Customers explicitly suspecting the merchant is intentionally misleading customers or operating fraudulently → use Merchant Fraud.
Order > Dispute > Canceled by merchant but not reflected in Tamara
This issue type covers customers whose cancellation was already confirmed by the merchant but has not yet been updated in Tamara.
This includes customers who:
1. Have confirmation from the merchant but the order still appears active.
2. Continue seeing charges after receiving cancellation confirmation.
3. Have proof of cancellation but Tamara has not yet reflected the update.
Does not include:
Customers still waiting for merchant confirmation or merchant action → use Return / Cancellation Not Processed.
Order > Dispute > Return/cancellation not processed
This issue type covers customers who requested a return or cancellation but the merchant has not yet processed, acknowledged, or completed the request.
This includes customers who:
1. Returned items but the merchant has not completed the return process.
2. Requested cancellation but have not received merchant confirmation.
3. Are waiting for the merchant to process a return or cancellation request.
Does not include:
Merchant-confirmed cancellations that are not yet reflected in Tamara → use Canceled by Merchant but Not Reflected in Tamara.
Other > Feedback > New feature or product request
This issue type covers customers who are suggesting or requesting a new feature, product, or capability they would like Tamara to offer. This includes customers who:
1. Suggest a new product or feature they would like to see on Tamara,
2. Ask whether a specific feature they want is planned or on the roadmap,
3. Request the reinstatement of a feature that was previously available.
Does not include: General feedback about the app or overall experience → use Other > Feedback > Feedback About Tamara
Other > Feedback > New merchant request
This issue type covers customers who want Tamara to partner with or be available at a merchant that does not currently accept Tamara. This includes customers who:
1. Request that a specific merchant be added to Tamara's network,
2. Ask why a particular merchant does not yet accept Tamara,
3. Ask how a merchant can sign up or apply to partner with Tamara.
Does not include: Feedback about an existing Tamara merchant → use Other > Customer Feedback About Merchant
Other > Could not find a relevant issue type
This issue type covers contacts that genuinely do not fit any existing issue type after reviewing available categories. Use this issue type only when no reasonable alternative exists.
Does not include:
1. Contacts that partially match an existing issue type.
2. Contacts that can reasonably fit under Account, Order, Payment, Refund, Promotion, Legal, or existing Other categories.
Other > Related to Collection agency
This issue type covers customers who have been contacted by a collection agency acting on Tamara's behalf, or who have concerns about the collection process. This includes customers who:
1. Received a call or message from a collection agency on behalf of Tamara,
2. Are disputing the amount the collection agency is asking them to pay,
3. Want to settle their outstanding balance directly with Tamara rather than through the agency,
4. Feel harassed or mistreated by the collection agency,
5. Want to know who authorized the collection agency to contact them.
Does not include: Customer asking about credit bureau reporting (SIMAH/AECB) → use Legal and Government > Credit Bureau > Credit Bureau Process & Report
Other > Customer feedback about merchant
This issue type covers customers who have general feedback or concerns about a specific merchant, not related to a particular order. This includes customers who:
1. Want to report poor or unsatisfactory service from a merchant in general,
2. Ask whether a specific merchant is legitimate or trusted on Tamara's platform,
3. Want to report a merchant as untrustworthy or unreliable based on their experience,
4. Ask why a specific merchant no longer accepts Tamara as a payment method.
Does not include: Merchant issues related to a specific order → use Order > Merchant Fraud or the relevant Order > Dispute type
Other > About Tamara (General)
This issue type covers customers with truly general questions about Tamara that do not fit any more specific category. This includes customers who:
1. Ask what Tamara is or how it works,
2. Ask how Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) works in general,
3. Ask whether Tamara is available in their country,
4. Ask about Tamara's business model or company background.
Does not include:
1. Payment failures or errors → Payment > Unable to Pay Pending Dues,
2. Questions about a specific charge → Payment > Autocharge or Unrecognized / Unrecorded Charge,
3. Declined orders → Order > Placing an Order > Declined Order,
4. Refund or return issues → Refunds and Cancellations,
5. Credit bureau questions → Legal and Government > Credit Bureau.
If a more specific category exists, always use it over this one.
Other > Feedback > Feedback about Tamara
This issue type covers customers who want to share general feedback about the Tamara app or overall service experience. This includes customers who:
1. Report that the Tamara app is slow, buggy, or difficult to use,
2. Share positive or negative feedback about their overall Tamara experience,
3. Compare Tamara unfavorably or favorably to a competitor as a general observation,
4. Suggest improvements to the app or service without requesting a specific new feature,
5. Share feedback about their experience following a resolved support interaction.
Does not include: Customer is requesting a specific new feature or product → use Other > Feedback > New Feature or Product Request
Other > Incomplete Contact > Authentication failed

Use this when a contact is closed because the customer could not be successfully authenticated. This includes when: The customer failed to correctly answer the required security or verification questions.
Other > Incomplete Contact > Call/chat connection issue
Use this when a contact is closed because the call or chat disconnected before the interaction was completed, with no indication that the disconnection was intentional by either party.
Other > Incomplete Contact > Call/chat dropped

Use this when a contact is closed because of a persistent connection problem that prevented the interaction from proceeding, and the disconnection was due to a technical issue rather than the customer or agent ending the contact.
Does not include: Call or chat that disconnected abruptly without warning → use Call / Chat Dropped
Other > Contact from merchant
Use this when the contact was initiated by a merchant rather than a customer.
Other > Incomplete Contact > No response from customer
Use this when a contact is closed because the customer did not respond to the agent's follow-up within the expected timeframe.
Other > Test contact
Use this for internal contacts sent as system or process tests. Do not use for any genuine customer interaction.
Other > Spam
Use this for contacts that are unsolicited, non-support-related, or clearly junk. Do not use for misfiled or unclear contacts; only for confirmed spam or irrelevant messages.
Other > Vulnerable Customer > Deceased Customer Case
This issue type covers contacts received from a family member, representative, or next of kin reporting that a Tamara account holder has passed away. This includes contacts where:
1. A family member or representative is notifying Tamara of the account holder's death,
2. The caller is requesting closure of the deceased's Tamara account,
3. The family is asking about any outstanding balance or instalments on the account,
4. The contact is requesting that Tamara stop sending communications or charges to the deceased's number,
5. The representative is asking what documentation (e.g. death certificate) is required to process the account closure.
Other > Vulnerable Customer > Customer with total physical disability

This issue type covers contacts from customers, or someone acting on their behalf, who have a physical disability that affects their ability to use or access Tamara independently. This includes contacts where:
1. A customer with a physical disability needs help completing an action on their account,
2. A representative, carer, or family member is contacting Tamara on the customer's behalf,
3. A representative is requesting a payment write-off or balance waiver on the customer's behalf,
4. A representative is requesting permanent closure of the customer's account due to their condition.
Other > Vulnerable Customer > Customer with total financial disability
This issue type covers customers who are experiencing severe financial hardship that affects their ability to meet their Tamara payment obligations. This includes customers who:
1. Have lost their job and are unable to make upcoming or overdue payments,
2. Are going through bankruptcy or a documented financial crisis,
3. Are requesting a payment plan adjustment, temporary freeze, or hardship arrangement,
4. Are unable to make any payments due to an extreme financial situation and are seeking support.
Does not include: Customer experiencing a technical error when attempting to pay → use Payment > Unable to Pay Pending Dues
Other > Fraudulent / Misleading Ads

This issue type covers customers who have seen or been misled by an advertisement or promotional content they believe is fraudulent, inaccurate, or not representative of Tamara's actual product or offer. This includes customers who:
1. Saw a Tamara advertisement with an offer or claim that does not match what is available in the app,
2. Believe an ad they encountered was not officially from Tamara and may be a scam or impersonation,
3. Were directed to Tamara through a misleading promotion and feel misled about the terms,
4. Want to report a suspicious ad using Tamara's name or branding.
Does not include: General feedback about Tamara's marketing → use Other > Feedback > Feedback About Tamara
Other > Campaign Post
This issue type covers customers who are contacting Tamara in response to, or with questions about, a specific campaign post or promotional content. This includes customers who:
1. Are reacting to or commenting on a Tamara campaign post (e.g. social media)
2. Have a question about an offer, promotion, or campaign they saw
3. Want to know if they are eligible for a campaign offer
4. Believe they should have received a campaign benefit but did not
Does not include:
Customer believes the ad is fraudulent or is impersonating Tamara → use Other > Fraudulent / Misleading Ads
General feedback about Tamara's marketing → use Other > Feedback > Feedback About Tamara
Other > Competition Post > No Reply Needed
To be used by the SM (social media) team, when resolving a case related to a competition, that doesn't require a reply.
Outbound > Outbound calling campaign
Use this when the contact was initiated by Tamara as part of an outbound calling campaign. This includes when: Tamara proactively contacted the customer for feedback, a survey, or a campaign.
Payment > Other
Use this only for general payment questions that genuinely do not fit any specific Payment sub-category. Before selecting this, confirm the issue is not about:
1. A failed or stuck payment → Unable to Pay Pending Dues,
2. An autocharge issue → Autocharge sub-categories,
3. A late fee → Late Fee,
4. An unrecognized charge → Unrecognized Charge sub-categories,
5. An unrecorded payment → Unrecorded Charges sub-categories,
6. A postponement request → Postpone Payment,
7. Processing fees → Customer Processing Fees,
8. A chargeback → Chargeback,
9. A high down payment → High Downpayment,
10. Profit rates or early settlement → Murabha sub-categories,
11. A card or payment method issue → Payment Methods sub-categories.

Valid uses: Customer asking how payments generally work on Tamara; customer asking about payment cycles or schedules in general terms; customer asking about their remaining outstanding dues; customer asking whether Tamara received their payment.
Payment > High Downpayment
This issue type covers customers who are surprised by or have questions about the down payment amount required for their Tamara order. This includes customers who:
1. Ask why the required down payment is 50% or more of their order value,
2. Notice the down payment percentage changed between viewing and confirming their order,
3. Want to understand how the down payment percentage is calculated,
4. Ask whether the down payment can be reduced,
5. Notice the down payment requirement differs across merchants and want an explanation.
Payment > Autocharge > Autocharge date
This issue type covers customers who have questions or concerns about the date on which Tamara automatically charges their payment method for a due instalment. This includes customers who:
1. Want to know exactly when the autocharge will debit their account,
2. Were charged on a date that does not match their expected payment schedule,
3. Were charged before the due date and want to understand why,
4. Want to know whether the autocharge date can be changed.
Does not include: Customer wants to postpone their payment → use Payment > Postpone Payment
Payment > Autocharge > Autocharge Amount
This issue type covers customers who have questions or concerns about the amount that was or will be automatically charged by Tamara. This includes customers who:
1. Were charged an amount different from their expected instalment amount,
2. Were charged more than their instalment amount and want an explanation,
3. Want to understand why the autocharge included late fees or additional amounts,
4. Were charged a partial amount and want to know why.
Does not include: Customer does not recognize the charge at all and suspects fraud → use Payment > Unrecognized Charge
Payment > Autocharge > Autocharge card
This issue type covers customers who have questions or concerns about which payment card or method Tamara used or will use for an automatic charge. This includes customers who:
1. Want to change the card linked to autocharge,
2. Had their old card charged instead of a newly added card,
3. Had an autocharge fail because their linked card has expired,
4. Want to know how to update their autocharge payment method.
Does not include: Customer cannot complete a manual payment → use Payment > Unable to Pay Pending Dues
Payment > Autocharge > Other
This issue type covers autocharge-related contacts that do not fall under autocharge date, amount, or card. This includes customers who:
1. Want to enable or disable autocharge on their account,
2. Ask how autocharge works,
3. Did not know autocharge was active and want it turned off,
4. Ask whether autocharge applies to all orders or only specific one.
Do not use this for general payment questions; only for autocharge-specific issues that do not fit the above sub-categories.
Payment > Late fee
This issue type covers customers who have questions or concerns about a late fee applied to their account. This includes customers who:
1. Were charged a late fee and want to understand why,
2. Believe a late fee was applied incorrectly or unfairly,
3. Want to know how much the late fee is and how it is calculated,
4. Are requesting a waiver or reversal of a late fee,
5. Ask whether late fees are subject to a grace period before being applied,
Does not include: Customer asking whether late fees are considered riba (interest) under Islamic law → use Legal and Government > Shariah Compliance.
Payment > Chargeback
This issue type covers customers who have initiated or are considering initiating a chargeback through their bank for a Tamara-related transaction. This includes customers who:
1. Have already filed a chargeback with their bank for a Tamara charge,
2. Want to understand how to initiate a chargeback for an unauthorized or disputed charge,
3. Have had a chargeback rejected by their bank and are seeking an alternative resolution,
4. Are asking how a chargeback will affect their Tamara account or credit standing.
Does not include:
1. Customer does not recognize a charge but has not initiated a chargeback → use Payment > Unrecognized Charge
2. Customer believes the merchant acted fraudulently → use Order > Merchant Fraud
Payment > Murabha - Pay By Finance > Profit Rates
This issue type covers customers who have questions about the profit rate applied to their Pay by Finance (Murabha) agreement. This includes customers who:
1. Want to know what profit rate applies to their Pay by Finance plan,
2. Ask what the APR (Annual Percentage Rate) is for their agreement,
3. Find the total repayment amount higher than expected and want to understand the profit markup,
4. Want to know whether the profit rate is fixed or variable,
5. Ask for a breakdown of principal versus profit in their instalment schedule,
6. Compare Tamara's profit rate to a bank loan rate and want clarification.
Does not include: Customer asking whether profit rates are halal or permissible under Islamic law → use Legal and Government > Shariah Compliance
Payment > Murabha - Pay By Finance > Early Settlement
This issue type covers customers who want to settle their Pay by Finance (Murabha) balance ahead of schedule. This includes customers who:
1. Want to pay off their remaining Murabha balance early,
2. Ask how to request early settlement,
3. Want to know the total amount required for early settlement,
4. Ask whether a discount or reduction applies for settling early,
5. Want to know whether early settlement will affect their credit score.
Payment > Payment Methods > Card is not accepted
This issue type covers customers whose payment card is being rejected or is not working on Tamara. This includes customers who:
1. Receive an error when attempting to add a card to their account,
2. Find that their card type is not supported by Tamara,
3. Have a card that is rejected during checkout or when making a payment,
4. Have a card that works on other platforms but is not accepted on Tamara.
Payment > Payment Methods > How to add/remove a card
This issue type covers customers who need help managing the payment cards linked to their Tamara account. This includes customers who:
1. Want to add a new debit or credit card to their account,
2. Want to remove an old or expired card,
3. Ask which card types are accepted on Tamara (e.g. Visa, Mastercard, Mada),
4. Cannot find the option to add or remove cards in the app.
Does not include: Customer wants to change which card is used for autocharge specifically → use Payment > Autocharge > Autocharge Card
Payment > High Down Payment
Customer is reaching out because the required down payment amount appears unusually high or unexpected.
Payment > Unrecognized charge > Suspected fraud
This issue type covers customers who report a charge from Tamara on their bank statement that they did not authorize and believe may be fraudulent. This includes customers who:
1. See a Tamara charge on their bank statement that they did not initiate,
2. Believe someone used their card to make a Tamara payment without their knowledge,
3. Report charges from Tamara on a card they never registered with Tamara.
Does not include:
1. Customer recognizes the charge after explanation → use Payment > Unrecognized Charge > Explained to Customer (No Issue)
2. Customer suspects their identity or National ID was used to create a Tamara account → use Account > Account Security > National ID Fraud
Payment > Unrecognized charge > Duplicate charge
This issue type covers customers who were charged more than once for the same Tamara transaction or instalment. This includes customers who:
1. Were charged twice for the same instalment,
2. Paid manually but Tamara's autocharge also deducted the same amount,
3. See two identical Tamara debits on their bank statement for a single transaction.
Does not include: Customer does not recognize the charge at all → use Payment > Unrecognized Charge > Suspected Fraud
Payment > Unrecognized charge > Explained to customer (no issue)
This issue type covers customers who reported an unrecognized charge that, upon investigation, was found to be a valid and correctly processed Tamara transaction. This includes customers who:
1. Did not recognize the charge description on their bank statement, which matched a valid Tamara instalment,
2. Forgot about an upcoming scheduled payment and mistook it for an unauthorized charge,
3. Were unfamiliar with how Tamara appears on bank statements and were confused by the billing descriptor.
Payment > Unrecorded charges > Payment authorization failed
This issue type covers customers who attempted to make a payment that failed at authorization, but whose bank account shows a deduction or pending charge. This includes customers who:
1. See a deduction or pending charge on their bank statement but Tamara shows the payment as failed,
2. Attempted to pay and had funds deducted, but the payment is not recorded in Tamara,
3. Have a pending charge on their bank account that has not been confirmed or released.
Does not include: Payment went through successfully but has not yet updated in Tamara → use Payment > Unrecorded Charges > Payment Not Reflected
Payment > Unrecorded charges > Payment not reflected
This issue type covers customers whose payment was successfully made but has not yet been recorded or reflected in Tamara's system. This includes customers who:
1. Paid via bank transfer but the payment is not showing in Tamara
2. Have proof of payment (receipt or screenshot) but Tamara still shows the instalment as unpaid
3. Made a payment through the app but their balance has not been updated
4. Made a payment hours or days ago that is still not reflected in their Tamara account
Does not include: Bank shows a deduction but Tamara recorded the payment as failed → use Payment > Unrecorded Charges > Payment Authorization Failed
Payment > Unrecorded charges > Other unrecorded charge issues
Use this only for unrecorded charge issues that do not fit either of the specific sub-categories. Before selecting this, confirm the issue is not about:
1. A payment that failed at authorization → Payment > Unrecorded Charges > Payment Authorization Failed
2. A payment that was made but not yet updated in Tamara → Payment > Unrecorded Charges > Payment Not Reflected
Payment > Postpone payment
This issue type covers customers who want to delay or reschedule an upcoming Tamara payment. This includes customers who:
1. Want to know how to postpone an upcoming instalment,
2. Ask whether postponing a payment is possible and what the conditions are,
3. Ask about the fee associated with postponing a payment,
4. Have already postponed a payment and want to postpone again,
5. Want to know how many times they are allowed to postpone.
Does not include: Customer cannot make a payment due to a technical error → use Payment > Unable to Pay Pending Dues
Payment > Customer Processing Fees
This issue type covers customers who have questions about or concerns with the processing fee applied to their Tamara order. This includes customers who:
1. Want to understand why a processing fee was applied to their order,
2. Did not expect the fee and want it explained before or after checkout,
3. Ask whether the processing fee is refundable,
4. Compare Tamara's processing fees to those of a competitor and want an explanation of the difference.
Payment > Unable to pay pending dues
This issue type covers customers who are experiencing difficulty making a payment toward their due instalments on Tamara. This includes customers who:
1. Attempt to pay but receive an error, such as a card decline, network issue, or payment timeout,
2. Find that the Pay Now button is greyed out, unresponsive, or the payment page fails to load,
3. Are unable to complete payment using Apple Pay,
4. Have a payment method that is not being accepted for instalment payments,
5. Have sufficient funds available but are still unable to complete the payment.
Promotions & Cashback > Cashback

3. Ask about the terms and conditions of a cashback offer,
4. Received less cashback than expected and want an explanation,

Promotions & Cashback > Discount
This issue type covers customers who have questions or issues related to a discount or promotional offer on Tamara. This includes customers who:

3. Did not have a discount applied to their order despite expecting one,

This issue type covers customers who are asking for guidance on how to return or cancel an order or item; no issue has occurred yet, they are seeking information only. This includes customers who:

2. Ask about the merchant's return or cancellation policy as it applies to Tamara orders,
3. Want to know whether they can partially cancel an order,
4. Ask what happens to their instalment plan if they return an item,
5. Ask about the return window or deadline for their order.
Does not include: Customer already submitted a return or cancellation request that has not been actioned → use Order > Dispute > Return / Cancellation Not Processed

This issue type covers customers whose order or item was canceled by the merchant without the customer requesting or consenting to the cancellation. This includes customers who:
1. Had their order canceled by the merchant without any notice or explanation,
2. Did not request a cancellation but received a cancellation confirmation from the merchant,
3. Want to know why their order was canceled by the merchant,
4. Are requesting a refund as a result of an unwanted merchant-initiated cancellation,
5. Want to reinstate or re-place an order that was incorrectly canceled.
Does not include: Customer requested a cancellation that has not yet been processed → use Order > Dispute > Return / Cancellation Not Processed
Refunds and Cancellations > Incorrect refund amount
This issue type covers customers who received a refund amount that does not match what they expected. This includes customers who:
1. Received a refund that is less than the price of the item they returned
2. Had their refund reduced by fees they were not expecting
3. Returned multiple items but were only refunded for some of them
4. Received a partial refund with no explanation of how the amount was calculated
5. Received an unexpected or unsolicited refund and want to understand why
Refunds and Cancellations > Late Refund > Refund failed
This issue type covers customers whose refund was initiated but failed to reach their account. This includes customers who:
1. Were told a refund was processed but the money never arrived in their account
2. Have confirmed with their bank that no refund was received

1. Believe they have not received their refund, but it has already been sent to their bank, card or wallet.
2. Need help locating the refund in their bank statement,
3. Had their refund processed to an old or expired card and need guidance on next steps,
Does not include: Refund was initiated but failed to arrive → use Refunds and Cancellations > Late Refund > Refund Failed

This issue type covers customers who are waiting for a refund that has not yet been processed by Tamara. This includes customers who:

2. Want to know why their refund is taking longer than expected,
3. Have a merchant-confirmed return that Tamara has not yet processed into a refund.

This issue type covers customers who have questions or concerns about a refund that was credited to their Tamara wallet. This includes customers who:

3. Find that their wallet balance does not match the expected refund amount,

Refunds and Cancellations > Refund Blocked by Merchant
This issue type covers customers whose refund cannot be processed because the merchant is unable or blocked from issuing it. This includes customers who:
1. Were told by the merchant that they are unable to process the refund,
2. Have a return or cancellation confirmed but the merchant is blocked from issuing the refund on the system,
3. Are requesting Tamara to intervene and process the refund directly on the merchant's behalf.

This issue type covers customers who have general questions about Tamara's Smart Membership and what it offers. This includes customers who:
Want to know what Smart Membership is and how it works,
Ask what benefits or perks are included in the membership,
Want to understand how Smart Membership differs from a standard Tamara account,
Ask about the cost of Smart Membership and whether it auto-renews,

Smart Membership > How to subscribe
This issue type covers customers who want to sign up for Tamara's Smart Membership or are experiencing issues during the subscription process. This includes customers who:

Attempted to subscribe but encountered an error or the process did not complete,
Were charged for a subscription but their membership is not showing as active,
Ask about any trial periods or promotional offers available for Smart Membership.

This issue type covers customers who want to cancel their Smart Membership subscription or are experiencing issues doing so. This includes customers who:

Attempted to unsubscribe via the app but the cancellation did not go through,
Were charged a membership fee after they believed they had already unsubscribed,
Ask whether they will receive a refund for the remaining membership period after cancelling,

Want to know when their next billing cycle or statement date is,
Have a general question about how Smart Membership billing works.
